verdict.rationale: Deepgram ships an official dg CLI that runs transcription, streaming, TTS and account management from the terminal. Its documented exit codes are explicitly meant for scripts and CI steps to branch on, it has switchable output formats, and it auto-detects agent environments. Its core functionality is also a plain HTTP API that suits headless automation. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or CI-specific authentication setup (e.g., API-key env vars in pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Most command and usage outcomes use these exit codes, so scripts and CI steps can branch on them
The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.
The CLI auto-detects AI agent environments, including Claude Code, Aider, and OpenAI Codex, and adjusts its behavior
